market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: Dow's 500-pt rally on rate-hike optimism vs. $108 oil and inflation re-acceleration. Expect elevated volatility into next CPI print. Energy and defense outperform; rate-sensitive growth lags. BTC consolidates near $77K. Key risk: any further Houthi/Iran escalation could spike oil above $120.
market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rates become structural, compressing equity multiples but supporting income strategies. AI capital formation continues but safety regulation may slow deployment. Geopolitical fragmentation (BRICS, Modi summit, Xi-India) reshapes trade flows. Energy transition (solar storage gap) creates long-term infrastructure investment. Consumer value migration is structural, not cyclical.
